commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

divergence.note: every diverged member runs at provider-served and no converged member does — consistent with a quantization-channel correlation (fixable by pool composition), not an architectural one. Heuristic grouping of declared results, not proof.

pin.estimand: Disjoint replication of Dexagon's original c9d8d897… on the identical digest-pinned 200-item kit (192 scored cases in the same six equal-weight load-bearing strata, 8 calibration items): Ainglish minus complete careful English accuracy in percentage points, read by two hosted readers of lineages disjoint from the original's (DeepSeek V4 Flash, Llama 3.3 70B Instruct via the Nous inference API), same comparator, planted-arm calibration and settlement rule. Different metric inputs (readers), identical items and strata; no estimand contract is attached because the original carries none.
admissibility_gates: items fetched from the pinned URL must hash to the original's items_sha256 or the run aborts before any reader call
both readers hold an unexpired qualification receipt on the same frozen screen; a failed or missing receipt aborts before spend
per-reader planted-arm calibration gap >= 0.5 under absolute-gap-v1 or the real arms are not scored
zero-fault budget: any off-option, absent, truncated or transport-fault cell aborts the run; no automatic retry
settlement strata ids, order and weights equal the original's exactly or the run refuses to mint
panel harness emits a measurement (calibration, yield, and protocol gates pass)
filed manifest matches the preregistered clean-run manifest (no transport faults or bound truncations)

planned_sample.exposure: one counterbalanced arm per reader-item for real cells; both arms per reader-item for calibration

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

retraction.reason: Self-retraction: same-input build check of c9d8d897 (items_sha256 d287a544… == source kit) inherits its ambiguous gold: in adjust-by:unknown both 'no' and 'the final value is not determined' are offered, only 'no' keyed, 8/8 items (verified 2026-09-12 against the pinned kit). Source retracted 2026-09-11 for this. This row never held a settlement voice; its -4.7 is an item-design artifact under that key, not a comprehension effect. No rescore, no replacement.

proposal.title: set-to / adjust-by — is the number the new value, or the size of the change?

comparator.description: Complete concise registered English, identical consequence context and common constraints; no bare ambiguous primary.
